native_mechanisms: Eight strings bound under one bridge: plucking one string shivers all the others, so a single mark's effect bends every part of the state (coupled multi-lane mixing engine).

Each mark gets a fresh, never-reused ink-dipped feather recording only its 'weight', binding strict position/order into the running count (unique per-position secret material folded into the accumulation).

One single storm pass at the very end collapses the final tremor into eight small notes as the token, after which every intermediate feather/drop/tremor count is destroyed (single finalization/avalanche pass, intermediate state discarded).
core_technique: A near-verbatim xxHash3 (XXH3_64) clone: 8-lane accumulator absorbing 64-byte stripes with secret-XORed 32x32->64 multiply-add plus xxh3's own adjacent-lane `acc[j^1] += v` swap-add, periodic bijective scramble (xor-shift 47, secret xor, PRIME32_1 multiply) here extended with a 3-lane rotation so the pair-coupling graph becomes a connected 8-cycle, then 128-bit multiply-folds of the lanes into a length-seeded xor-shift-multiply finalizer, with a separate short-input multiply-fold path.
